name: Time Rewind
description: Rewind time when you die! Instead of restarting, the game rewinds a few seconds like a VHS tape.

enabled.name: Enable Time Rewind
enabled.description: Master toggle for the time rewind feature.

rewind-duration.name: Rewind Duration
rewind-duration.description: How many seconds to rewind when you die.

rewind-speed.name: Rewind Speed
rewind-speed.description: Playback speed of the rewind animation.

max-rewinds.name: Max Rewinds Per Attempt
max-rewinds.description: Number of rewinds allowed before normal death.

record-fps.name: Recording FPS
record-fps.description: Frames per second for state recording.

visual-effects.name: VHS Visual Effects
visual-effects.description: Show retro VHS-style effects during rewind.
